facts.fact: Ulises 复盘昨夜败露：本该烧掉那些信，父亲绝不会犯这种低级错误；他自认是父亲的「不及格的影子」。
facts.anchor: His father would never have committed such a gaffe. His father had been clever. Ulises was an inept shadow of his old man.

facts.fact: 晚饭收盘时 Inés 弯腰在他耳边低声补刀：「我告诉过你试试看」——把他昨夜的挫败记在账上。
facts.anchor: “I told you to give it a try,” she whispered.

facts.fact: 他向 Perla 提议开车去看瀑布，Inés 大声插嘴指路「魔鬼椅」，被姨妈斥为无礼后假意道歉，转手端来滚烫的咖啡烫了他的舌头。
facts.anchor: “Are you going to the Devil?” the girl asked loudly.

facts.fact: 瀑布前他正要向 Perla 大献殷勤，雨落，不得不打道回府——独处计划再度泡汤。
facts.anchor: Yet before he could utter a single word, the rain began to fall.

facts.fact: 晚上他听 Perla 弹 Chopin 后夸「Brava」，顺势吻手如 Romeo——她脸色一硬、起身离场，他彻底傻眼。
次日清晨报纸未到，他下楼撞见 Inés 正教家童 Fito 练舞（为了让他敢请 Paloma 跳舞），仆人们围着看乐子。
facts.anchor: He found her in the dining room, dancing with the houseboy, of all things.

facts.fact: Inés 亮出反制条款：你敢告发我跳舞的事，我就没法给你送报纸了——两人互握把柄。
facts.anchor: “My aunt doesn’t know about it. If you tell, she’ll punish me.

facts.fact: 二轮谈判他开价三分之二，还自夸「慷慨」。
facts.anchor: “I’ve thought about what you said, and I believe, considering the risk and work that this entails, it would be best if I retained two-thirds of any money we might be able to obtain,” he told her.

facts.fact: Inés 用风险不对称压价：败露了他换个目标，她被扫地出门——坚持对半。
facts.anchor: “Half. The risk is mine. If we’re found out, you can scam another woman, but I’ll be kicked out of the house,” she replied with a maddening assuredness.

facts.fact: 他抱怨活儿重，她回敬「你干的不过是跟女人做爱，那算什么艺术」；两人唇枪舌剑后握手——对半分账成交。
facts.anchor: “You talk as if you need to sow a tobacco field from dusk until dawn, when all you need to do is make love to a woman. That’s no art.”
